function make() {
  const f = () => 1;
  console.log(f.tag);
  f.tag = "t";
  return f;
}
make();
function named() {
  return 2;
}
console.log(named.label);
named.label = "n";
(() => {
  console.log(k.size);
})();
const k = () => 3;
k.size = 1;
const e = () => 4;
console.log(e["label"]);
e.label = "e";
const g = () => 5;
if (g() > 2) {
  g.tag = "g";
}
console.log(g.tag);
